title: Cat With Amusing Expression Laps Up Water Accumulated on Table
description: This cat had come back home from a long walk with her owner in the Swiss countryside. Since she was thirsty, she decided to drink from a small puddle of water accumulated on a table on the terrace. As she did so, her facial expression stayed frozen the whole time, not even looking down at the water she was lapping up.
